boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Spelman College
boards.description: Current campus and adjacent-campus dining destinations with published evening service times.

cards.title: Spelman After Dark at The Suites
cards.subtitle: Spelman College
cards.notes: Check the current Spelman After Dark schedule before heading over; Friday and Saturday service is listed through 11 p.m.

cards.title: Dinner at Alma Upshaw Café

cards.evidence_claim: Spelman lists Alma Upshaw Café dinner from 4:30–9 p.m. Monday–Thursday, with the café closing at 8 p.m. Friday.
cards.source_title: Dining Services | Spelman College | Atlanta, GA
cards.access_notes: Published weekday dinner ends at 9 p.m.; Friday closing is 8 p.m.; weekend dinner ends at 7 p.m.
